items.title: IRGC attacks US unmanned vessel seeking access to Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – The Naval Forces of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) have attacked a US military unmanned surface vessel (USV) that was attempting to enter the protected area of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Iran strikes back after US targets its tankers
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has responded to the aggression of the US military in attacking three Iranian tankers by firing three missiles from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: IRGC targets US aircraft carrier, destroyer in ballistic missile attack
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has announced that its Aerospace Force had targeted a US aircraft carrier and a destroyer with several ballistic missiles during an ongoing maritime confrontation.
